topic: What happens if you drink only seawater?
title: Drinking Only Seawater
hook: What if seawater was all you could drink?

beats.label: 1 CUP
beats.line: Seawater is about three and a half percent salt.

beats.label: 4 CUPS
beats.line: Your kidneys can't make urine that salty, so they use your own water.

beats.label: 1 DAY
beats.line: You get thirstier with every sip, the opposite of what you need.

beats.label: 2 DAYS
beats.line: Your blood thickens, and your brain turns foggy and confused.

beats.label: 3 DAYS
beats.line: That's why lost sailors are told never to drink the sea.

end.line: Would you take one sip of seawater?

description: Water everywhere, but not a drop to drink: why seawater makes you thirstier.

facts.claim: Seawater has an average salinity of about 3.5%.
Human kidneys can only make urine that is less salty than seawater, so drinking it costs more water than it gives.
Dehydration thickens the blood and causes confusion.
